purpose: Correct source anatomy: forward projection is gesturing pectoral fin, normal toothy mouth above.

arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create one smooth inked cartoon game sprite from Image 1, exact original SLEVEJM2 000. Images 2 and 3 supply only the already established SHARK identity: medium neutral gray body, pale ivory underside, sharp triangular razor teeth, gill slits and sly half-lidded brow. Match Image 1's rear three-quarter right-facing posture and anatomy. The shark is upright chest-high above water, mostly gray back/flank with a narrow pale belly edge at right. Its compact head is at upper-right, with small sly eye high under brow, short tapered upper snout and a NORMAL compact toothy mouth below it. CRITICAL: the long projection pointing toward image-right BELOW THE MOUTH is the far PECTORAL FIN gesturing forward, its tip curving slightly down. Draw it as a separate fin attached at the chest/shoulder BELOW THE JAW, never as an elongated chin, lower jaw or beak. The normal pale lower jaw must end beneath the upper snout, clearly separate above the gesturing fin. The near pectoral fin hangs down against the left flank. One dorsal fin lies back-left along the back. No extra fin on top of the forehead, no horns, no third pectoral fin. Preserve the original silhouette, original shoulder-high fin gesture and original waterline. Sharp sneaky shark expression, not angry snarling or cute innocence. Bold clean black outlines and restrained cel shading matching references. Thin white/cyan ripples only where the original shows water. No submerged body, tail, legs or hands. Actual transparent RGBA background with transparent padding on all sides; no checkerboard, scene, shadow, glow, text or collage.
